examples.text: Computer users these days expect immediate results when they click on a link.

glosses: Embedded as part of the instruction itself, rather than stored elsewhere (such as a register or memory location).

examples.text: Bravo Three, this Bravo Six. Immediate! We are coming under fire from the north from an unknown enemy, over!

glosses: An artillery fire mission modifier for two types of fire mission to denote an immediate need for fire: Immediate smoke, all guns involved must reload smoke and fire. Immediate suppression, all guns involved fire the rounds currently loaded and then switch to high explosive with impact fused (unless fuses are specified).

examples.text: Hotel Two-Niner, this is Bravo Six. Immediate suppression at grid November-Kilo four-five-three two-one-five. Danger Close. I authenticate Golf Echo, over.

examples.text: La distinction des pensées ou connoissances, en médiates & immédiates prouve encore moins la prétendue imperceptibilité des pensées.

glosses: Qui suit ou précède sans intervalle.
